method.serializedSize: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify(snapshot); this includes presentation source fields and is not JavaScript heap usage
method.statistics: Median averages the middle pair for even sample counts; p95 uses nearest rank ceil(n * 0.95); raw millisecond samples are retained
